name: io.github.EricSeokgon/egovframe-scaffold-mcp
description: Scaffold, assemble, diagnose and migrate Korean eGovFrame (전자정부 표준프레임워크) projects: official templates, common components, CRUD/config generation, build/test, 5.x (Jakarta) migration and dependency checks.

environmentVariables.name: EGOVFRAME_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path-separator-delimited list of directories the write tools may touch (see README '보안 설정').

environmentVariables.name: EGOVFRAME_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. 'en' exposes English tool descriptions in tools/list (responses stay Korean).
